purpose: Exact file-level inventory for a human P3 review-range expansion. It authorizes neither a P0 baseline rewrite nor main merge nor deployment.

inclusionRules: all changed docs/prototypes/full-page-flow-prototype-*.test.mjs directly invoked by scripts/verify.mjs
changed root gate configuration: AGENTS.md, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml
changed P0 baseline contract JSON: three-surface-approved-visual-changes.json, three-surface-baseline.json, three-surface-byte-artifacts.json, three-surface-migration-backlog.json
gateAndCiSelection.rationale: No changed automation helper is excluded from B5. Prototype visual artifacts are not automation code; only the four named P0 contract JSON files are included.

testOwnershipRule.invariant: No apps/mobile/tests/** or packages/core/tests/** entry is assigned to B5 solely because it is a test.
